generalAbilities.name: Smoke Vision
generalAbilities.description: Smoke doesn't impair a solar crow's vision; they ignore the Concealed condition from smoke.

defensiveAbilities.name: Glinting Wing
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 120 feet attempts to target the solar crow

Effect The solar crow defensively repositions a wing to shine light into the attacker's eyes. The target is Dazzled for the duration of the triggering effect, granting the solar crow concealment against it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Glow
defensiveAbilities.description: 25 feet. The solar crow casts bright light in a 25ft Emanation (and dim light for the next 25 feet).

offensiveAbilities.name: Blinding Heat
offensiveAbilities.description:
The solar crow expands its wings and unleashes blazing hot, blinding light in a 120ft Emanation. Each creature in the area takes 9d6 Fire Damage damage with a DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save. The crow can't use Blinding Heat again for 1d4 rounds, and its glow aura is deactivated during this time.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and is Dazzled for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is Blinded for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is blinded for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Burning Talons
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature Grabbed by the solar crow takes 1d4 Persistent,fire Damage damage. It can't recover from this damage while grabbed by the crow.

offensiveAbilities.name: Snatch
offensiveAbilities.description: A solar crow can Fly at half Speed while it has a creature Grabbed or Restrained in its talons, carrying that creature along with it.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
